title: Observability, audit and operational evidence architecture
flow: Generate trace and correlation context at authenticated entry
Propagate scoped context through API and asynchronous event links
Record domain and security audit decisions in append-only controlled storage
Emit redacted service logs, metrics and latency/queue gauges
Alert on reconciliation exception, unauthorized attempt and stale external outcome
Support authorized, reproducible event export with chain-of-custody record
rules: Audit evidence must identify actor, institution, action, object, outcome and time
Logs cannot contain passwords, HSM keys, unmasked tokens or unnecessary identity documents
Operational health indicators cannot substitute for financial reconciliation
Financial-journal source records, application events and telemetry retain separate provenance
Protect audit evidence from ordinary application update/delete paths
Define per-institution, lawful retention and secure export entitlements
test_cases: Sensitive token values never appear in captured logs
Audit export cannot cross institution boundary
Outbox publish delay creates distinct alert
Audit reconstruction links command, journal, external evidence and approval
Unauthorized audit deletion request is denied and recorded
approval_gate: Institution retention approval, security logging architecture and independent audit reviewer acceptance.
